root_cause.summary: Training session service and Compose stack had unconfigured empty defaults for Persona and Governance URL templates, and PR6347 head f4f0412a3 used a plain service-token fallback that could not pass Governance strict JWT validation. In addition, _persona_authority_token had broad exception fallback, _ensure_persona accepted 409 conflicts without tenant/identity verification readback, and the stimulus test harness lacked Persona service registration.
root_cause.introduced_by: Initial L12 training session compose template placeholders and missing test fixture setup
root_cause.why_unnoticed: Isolated testing mocked target preconditions while deployed gates failed at L4 evaluation dependency check; previous PR6347 attempted plain service token fallback without fail-closed credential contract
root_cause.detected_by: L12-LEARNING-PERSONA-OWNER-WIRING-20261008 coordinator rejection and dispatch gate logs

docker-compose.yml: Configured default URL templates for TRAINING_SESSION_PERSONA_READBACK_URL_TEMPLATE, TRAINING_SESSION_APPROVAL_READBACK_URL_TEMPLATE, TRAINING_SESSION_PERSONA_TARGET_WRITE_URL_TEMPLATE, and TRAINING_SESSION_PERSONA_TARGET_READBACK_URL_TEMPLATE.
Removed plain Persona service-token fallback; defaults TRAINING_SESSION_PERSONA_AUTHORITY_TOKEN and TRAINING_SESSION_PERSONA_AUTHORITY_TOKEN_FILE to empty, requiring configured consumer credentials.
services/training-session/main.py: Updated _persona_authority_token to use configured_service_token fail-closed without broad exception fallback or plain service-token fallback.
services/training-session/tests/test_mai: Added regression tests for _persona_authority_token fail-closed file vs env rules, including missing, unsafe, and invalid credential file negatives.
scripts/run_isolated_l12_runtime_e2e.py: Registered persona in STIMULUS_SERVICES, configured PERSONA_JWT_* and PANTHEON_PERSONA_SERVICE_TOKEN in _isolated_dev_principal_env, and added persona.admin to PANTHEON_L12_OPERATOR_TOKEN.
scripts/test_run_isolated_l12_runtime_e2: Updated STIMULUS_SERVICES unit assertions to include persona.
tests/integration/l12/test_current_resea: Added self.persona_url and _ensure_persona helper with GET readback asserting exact persona_id and tenant_id match on creation and 409 conflict.
tests/integration/l12/test_current_human: Added self.persona_url and _ensure_persona helper with GET readback asserting exact persona_id and tenant_id match on creation and 409 conflict.

chain_scope_distinction: L4 _case_persona_teaching deployed E2E verifies evaluation execution and Training terminal-readback against the real Persona owner pre-condition. Downstream approval -> Persona CAS write -> durable Persona readback is verified by unit suites test_persona_target.py and test_training_target_owner.py, with hosted CAS mutation obligations retained.
